name: apyguard-apiscout-plugin
description: Discover APIs locally, review source-backed findings, open the APIScout Workbench, create ApyGuard assets, and work with OpenAPI documents.

interface.shortDescription: Discover and document APIs from local source code.
interface.longDescription: Connect an ApyGuard account through a browser sign-in, then inspect local backend projects in the interactive APIScout Workbench, review API inventory findings, gather endpoint evidence, export OpenAPI, and compare specifications without VS Code.
defaultPrompt: Scan this project with APIScout and summarize the API findings.
Open the APIScout Workbench for this project.
List the ApyGuard asset and API collections for this project.
